newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends slightly up vs dlr on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends slightly up vs dlr on quiet market.

text.p: Hungary's forint finished a shade stronger against the dollar in lacklustre pre-Christmas trade on Monday, dealers said.
Dealers said only a few banks were active on Monday.
The forint was range-bound between 160.15 and 160.30 to one dollar and closed at 160.20, compared with 160.25/30 at midday.

Dealers said the dollar/mark, which usually influences the forint, hardly moved on Monday and the forint drifted a few pips nearer the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (bid) by the end of trading from some 15 pips at midday.
The 40 to 50 filler gap of the past two weeks was substantially narrower on Monday as year-end foreign currency buyings ended, dealers said.

They added that this movement, along with with yen, Italian lire and Swiss franc sales boosted speculative business on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), with the daily currency futures turnover on the BCE rising to a record 13.56 billion forint from 9.73 billion forints on Friday.
